cv.profile_text: Software developer with a passion for problem-solving and optimisation. I love learning about new technologies and techniques.

projects.name: Handheld console
bullets: Python application compiles a custom assembly-based language into formatted binary code
This file can then be uploaded to the console via USB
Interpreter written in C reads the binary code and executes it
Managing communication with digital tooling: OpenProtocol, Modbus/TCP, Keyence Non-procedural (TCP/IP stack).
Customised daily reports with own code.
Customised software for specific engineering projects. For example measurements with various tooling and calculations applied to them.
Database queries for both reporting and accelerated configuration.
Researching and investigating back-end solutions to perform over-the-air updates.
Researching and investigating front-end solutions to update both embedded-linux and low-end embedded systems over-the-air.
